a: Up to $1M total over 2 years per team; 3–4 teams in the pilot year
dt: Letter of intent was due Nov 9, 2026; full applications from that round are due Jul 1, 2027. The next call is not posted yet.
e: Teams of 3–5 non-hierarchical investigators at US or Canadian universities, labs or institutes, each within 10 years of their first independent position, working in basic physical sciences (physics incl. astrophysics and biophysics, astronomy, chemistry, materials, Earth and planetary science). A person may join only one LOI. At Yale, contact zandra.ruiz@yale.edu (Corporate & Foundation Relations).

yale.t: Yale applicants should contact Yale Corporate and Foundation Relations before applying (Yale funding newsletter, Oct 7, 2026).
